services.desc: ENJOY IN PERSON ON OPENING DAY: The Opening Reception is Friday, September 11 from 5-7pm. Meet the artists, enjoy live music in the Upstairs Gallery performed by harpist, Meredith Kohn Bocek and savor tasty treats created by Old World Cafe while mingling with fellow art lovers and community members. Featured Artists Trish Coonrod, Tom Gardner, Christina Johnson, and Jennifer Miller plan to be in attendance. This is a family friendly event. Anyone who has not yet visited the Gallery is highly encouraged to attend this event which is free and open to the public. We hope you can join us! blurb: Small-town Gallery. World-class Talent. We’re a friendly, family owned and operated fine arts gallery celebrating 49 years on historic Market Street in Corning, NY. We’re proud to represent 50 exceptional professional artists working in a variety of mediums.
